title: One AI Conversation Can Cost 500 Milliliters Of Water
hook: One AI conversation can consume 500 milliliters of water.
closing: Every chat adds pressure to a shared water supply.
question: Should AI disclose its water cost?

segments.say: Microsoft's water use reached 6.4 million cubic meters, more than tripling since 2017.
Google used 21.2 million cubic meters, showing how large the AI water race became.
One AI conversation can cost 500 milliliters of water, turning prompts into physical demand.
